# A finite-bit quantized full-law kinetic receiver

29 October 2026. New implementation and construction, independent whole
review pending. This closes an output-format gate for the direct complex
dual; it does not extend that dual to velocity-dependent collision rates.
No historical novelty or practical all-solver advantage is claimed.

## Exact output contract

Input time t is a nonnegative rational. The initial distribution is the
equal mixture of two centered three-dimensional Gaussian distributions,
with rational covariance matrices

    Sigma1=diag(1,21/20,11/10),
    Sigma2=[[26/25,1/25,0],[1/25,26/25,0],[0,0,21/20]].

They lie between I and (11/10)I. The nonlinear Maxwell collision uses
independent velocities and one of the four signed x/y quarter-turn
rotations, each with probability 1/4, with A=(I+R)/2 and B=(I-R)/2.
Its rate is one. The output is three INTEGERS

    (floor(4V1),floor(4V2),floor(4V3)), V distributed as f_t.

The law is exact conditional on an iid fair-bit input and the stated
outward-ball arithmetic contract. A seeded PRNG execution is a diagnostic
of that program, not a proof that a deterministic seed supplies iid bits.
Neither a discrete law nor this finite output is asserted TV-close to the
unrounded continuous distribution. The mathematical target is its exact
pushforward under the specified quantizer.

## Preserved ideal-real operation

The accepted direct-complex proof and the accepted finite-kernel contraction
give the following ideal-real operation. Use a=1,b=11/10,c=21/20,h=1/20,
C=b^(3/2). Propose v from N(0,bI), draw xi from N(0,I), put
z=xi-i v/b, and draw q from Poisson(h||z||^2/2). The finite-kernel marked
dual supplies a bounded complex H_q(z/||z||,t), of modulus at most one.
Then

    W/C=Re[(-1)^q exp(i(c/b-1)xi dot v) H_q]

is bounded by one, and its conditional expectation is f_t(v)/(C g_b(v)).
The p-coin with probability (1-W/C)/2 therefore has mean p satisfying
2p <=1-ell(v)/C, where ell=exp[-||v||^2(1-1/b)/2]>0.
Huber's established linear Bernoulli factory produces a 2p-coin; accept
the proposal on output zero. This gives f_t exactly, with expected C
proposals. The ordinary expected-query bound is finite when b<2a.

four rational rotations, and allocates q marks by Binomial(q,U),

# A paid equilibrium alternative for the same finite collision kernel

29 October 2026. Root reconstruction, independent review pending. This is
an explicit ordinary comparator, not a claim of a new equilibrium principle.
Its output is an approximation at a displayed TV tolerance. It must not be
reported as the exact transient sample contract.

Let Sigma be the random Gaussian covariance, aI<=Sigma<=bI, and let
mu=Tr E(Sigma0)/3. Put D=Sigma-mu I, M=E D and V=E||D||_F^2. The collision
updates D to A D1 A^T+B D2 B^T with independent input copies, where
A=(I+R)/2,B=(I-R)/2 and R is uniform over the four x/y quarter-turns.

The mean evolves by dM/dt=(E_R R M R^T-M)/2. On real symmetric traceless
matrices this self-adjoint operator has eigenvalues -1/4,-1/2,-3/4; hence

    ||M_t||_F^2 <= exp(-t/2)||M_0||_F^2.

For a quarter-turn about x, P=A^T A=diag(1,1/2,1/2) and Q=B^T B=I-P;
about y, P=diag(1/2,1,1/2). The signs have the same P,Q. In the sum
E_R Tr(D P D P+D Q D Q), squared diagonal entries of x,y have coefficient
3/4, that of z coefficient1/2, and every squared off-diagonal contribution
coefficient1/2. It is therefore at most (3/4)||D||_F^2.
The cross term in the independent-copy update is bounded above by
2||A M A^T||_F ||B M B^T||_F <=2||M||_F^2. Consequently

    V'_t <= -V_t/4+2exp(-t/2)||M_0||_F^2,
    V_t <= exp(-t/4)[V_0+8||M_0||_F^2] <=9V_0 exp(-t/4).

For Sigma,mu I>=aI, the elementary Gaussian relative-entropy formula and
the Taylor bound on x-1-log x give

    D(N(0,Sigma)||N(0,mu I)) <=||Sigma-mu I||_F^2/(4a^2).

Pinsker, convexity of TV under mixing, and Cauchy--Schwarz yield

    TV(f_t,N(0,mu I)) <=3sqrt(V_0)/(2sqrt(2)a) exp(-t/8).   (E1)

Integer quantization cannot increase this bound. For the declared catalog,
mu=157/150 and V0 can be computed exactly from the two rational matrices;
the conservative V0<=3(b-a)^2=3/100 already suffices. Its prefactor is less
than 1/5. Thus for any epsilon>0, t>=8log[1/(5epsilon)] pays the requested
bin-law error by using an ordinary single Gaussian with covariance mu I.
For example t>=100 is safely enough for epsilon=10^-6. The Gaussian is
sampled/quantized by the same lazy-normal and strict-ball arithmetic, not
by a finite floating approximation whose TV error is silently ignored.

# Independent whole-review of the quantized Maxwell receiver

29 October 2026. Read-only intake of root_quantized_collision/{PROOF.md,
quantized.py,consume.py,EXECUTION.json,EQUILIBRIUM_CONTROL.md,equilibrium.py,
EQUILIBRIUM_EXECUTION.json}, together with the previously accepted direct
complex/finite-kernel derivations. No producer module or sample grid is rerun
by this review. Expected-work strengthening is treated separately below.

## Exact target and whole program

ACCEPTED analytically at the stated conditional scope: under iid fair bits
and convergent outward Arb/acb arithmetic, the program terminates almost
surely and returns exactly the integer-bin pushforward of the declared
Maxwell/covariance-mixture model at a nonnegative rational time. This is not
an exact continuous-valued machine output, empirical model acquisition or
hard-sphere receiver. It consumes the fixed rational four-rotation kernel
and the exact positive singleton program; no Haar sampler is hidden.

I checked the code and proof in full. The two initial covariance catalogs
in Receiver and consume.initial agree: cI+h E gives diag(1,21/20,11/10) or
the stated rational 2x2 block and 21/20 third entry. Transpose quadratics,
Hermitian child norms, occupied-only normalization and the Poissonized
phase/covariance constants agree with the earlier complete-law theorem.
The finite singleton applies its four exp(-left/4) coins also when left is
a computable real, not merely a rational time. Categorical denominators and
weights are exact integers; the runtime group map uses the correct transpose.

Every Uniform owns one persistent prefix. Cached coarse enclosures remain
valid after later refinement, although they can waste already acquired bits.
Normal inversion reuses its one uniform through rational-CDF bisections.
Inverse-Poisson comparisons reuse one uniform and increasing cumulative
probabilities. Fresh variables are not resampled after unresolved comparisons.
Strict upper/lower ball comparisons control every noninteger branch. Generic
integer powers were correctly replaced by polynomial multiplication, including
exact-zero components and negative powers of a strictly positive factory base.

The Huber factory preserves its multiplier-two martingale with geometrical
increment, the epsilon clamp, the threshold computed before that clamp, and
the subsequent multiplier/margin updates. Source prim
